doc_title: Software Requirements Specification for KeePass Password Safe

requirements.text: System features are organized by use cases and functional hierarchy so that the main functions of the system will be understandable.
It is the first thing a user must do to begin using KeePass.
Its main function is the determination of the master password that will unlock the database from now on

details.conflicting_text: Its main function is the determination of the master password that will not unlock the database from now on

requirements.text: Master Password has no limits in length. A whole sentence can be used with more than 100 characters.
When the database is found, the master password is wanted so that the database will be unlocked.
Folder selected must be of type the database can read and that is "name".kdb

details.stated_text: Folder selected must be of type the database

requirements.text: Databases must have different names or else the previews one will be replace if selected
There must be entries in the database in order for them to be printed

details.stated_text: There must be entries in the database in order for them to be printed

requirements.text: This is very useful when the user needs to find out very quickly which password is required in one account or what username he has put on another account.

details.proposed_text: This is very useful when the administrator needs to find out very quickly which password is required in one account or what username he has put on another account.

requirements.text: By writing just one character the database will present all data which contains it or are related with it.
All data related to the word must be shown. For example if user types "abc" and abc is part of a password and of a username, both entries must be shown
When creating a group/subgroup the user must select a name and then he can add entries into it.
A name is required in order for the new group/subgroup to be created
A subgroup cannot be created when no group is selected
A name is required in order for the group/subgroup to be renamed
In order for that to happen, he must have chosen first a group/subgroup.

details.conflicting_text: In order for that to happen, he must not have chosen first a group/subgroup.

requirements.text: In order to find something in a group a word must be placed in the find field
He can fill in fields like: group where the entry will be added, title, user name, password, repeat password, URL, notes, expiration date and attachment file.
An entry must belong to a group to be created
When the password field is completed the repeat password field must be completed

details.stated_text: When the password field is completed the repeat

requirements.text: Password field and repeat password field must be identical
In order for that to happen, the user must select an entry first.

details.stated_text: In order for that to happen, the user must select an entry first.

An entry must be selected before it is duplicated

details.stated_text: An entry must be selected

requirements.text: All the user has to do is to select change language from the view menu and then the language he wants.
Doing this he will be transferred at KeePass website and choose the language he wants for downloading.
An internet connection and a browser are required in order to download new language translations For the following features, use cases are not included
This feature allows user to define a sequence of keypresses which KeePass will automatically perform.

details.stated_text: This feature allows user to define a sequence of keypresses which KeePass will automatically perform.

requirements.text: The sequence must be prefixed with "Auto-Type" and length of one line.
If a sequence is more than a line it cannot be used and in case of two sequences in one note's field only the first one is used.
The prefix "Auto-Type:" is required in front of each sequence

details.stated_text: The prefix "Auto-Type:" is required in front of each sequence

requirements.text: Sequence's length must not be more than a line (59 characters)
If two auto-types are referred in one note field, only the first is used
This feature allows user to pass a file patch in the command line so that KeePass will open it immediately after start up.
Only one database file is allowed in command line options
In case a space is found in the path, it must be enclosed into quotes
If a master password is required to unlock the database, the database doesn't open unless the password is entered

details.stated_text: If a master password is required to unlock the database, the database doesn't open unless the password is entered

requirements.text: If a key file is required to unlock the database, the database doesn't open unless the key file is present

details.missing: unless the key file is present
details.stated_text: If a key file is required to unlock the database, the database doesn't open

requirements.text: If there is a composite key, both master password and key file are required
In case of lost master password or key file, the database never unlocks again. There is no recovery
There is no backdoor or key that unlocks all databases
File formats are not specialized password database formats
File formats only specify a low-level layout of stored data
Global hot key cannot be changed
When TAN are created, they appear as typical entries which in the field title contain "TAN" so that KeePass will know it's a TAN.

details.stated_text: When TAN are created, they appear as typical entries which in the field title contain "TAN" so that KeePass will know it's a TAN.

requirements.text: In TAN entries, user cannot change the title, user name or URL but notes can be added.
Title, username or URL cannot be changed in a TAN entry.

requirements.text: When a TAN is used, it expires automatically and can never be used again.
At this time the main database window is inactive and cannot be accessed unless the current active window is closed.
If in the meanwhile it is not pasted anywhere, it must be copied again.

details.stated_text: If in the meanwhile it is not pasted anywhere, it must be copied again.

requirements.text: That happens so that if user copies a password and not paste it anywhere, the password cannot be found by anyone later.
When a USB which contains the database is removed from a computer while changes haven't been completely saved, the database is damaged and cannot be opened.

details.stated_text: When a USB which contains the database is removed from a computer while changes haven't been completely saved, the database is damaged and cannot be opened.
